settings.markdown:
## How competitions work
- A new skill or boss competition starts most weeks; the schedule is on the Competitions page.
- Sign up in our Discord. Your gains count from the start time, wherever you are in game.
- Prizes come from the clan coffer and are paid in game.

items.q: Do I have to be good to join?
items.a: No. Most competitions have prizes for the biggest improvement, not only the top spot.
